title.zh: 【Consensys 发布椭圆曲线安全检查加速算法，已集成至开源密码学库】
title.en: 【Consensys 发布椭圆曲线安全检查加速算法，已集成至开源密码学库】

current_state.zh: Consensys researchers published a Divide-and-Pair method that accelerates elliptic-curve subgroup membership checks, achieving 1.3x–10.8x speedups across several curves, and integrated it into the open-source gnark-crypto library.
current_state.en: Consensys researchers published a Divide-and-Pair method that accelerates elliptic-curve subgroup membership checks, achieving 1.3x–10.8x speedups across several curves, and integrated it into the open-source gnark-crypto library.
